market.what: selenium treatment of mine water and coal-power FGD wastewater (bioreactors, IX, membranes), world
market.method: Elk Valley: >US$1B invested + ~$500M more by end-2027 (~$250M/yr capex+opex) + US FGD/Appalachian coal/phosphate/refining ~$250M/yr (est.); TrendX report says $1.4B (looks high)

value.logic: bioreactors cost ~$30M per 300-400 gpm; EVR ~US$1B for ~78 ML/d; selenate-over-sulfate binder lets small IX + reduction replace big bio plants: ~30% cut on ~$500M/yr = ~$150M/yr
value.revenue_logic: sorbent sales + licence to a mine-water integrator; ~2.5% of ~$500M by yr 7
value.margin_logic: specialty selective resin, small tonnage, priced on avoided capex

trend.drivers: Elk Valley Water Quality Plan; BC fines ($3.6M); coal mine extensions; US ELG FGD selenium limits (deadlines extended 2025); est. (report 13.2% looks high)

competition.notes: OpenAlex count not run: free daily budget for this IP used up (429, resets midnight UTC); re-run. No 2012+ startup found; WashU/EPRI/WaterTectonics iron electrocoagulation ($1.25M DOE) is closest new approach. Sulfate competition is the known weak point of today's IX

lab.synth: 3-5 step custom: bis-squaramide receptor with ammonium linker, then grafting to resin
lab.test: batch + column in synthetic mine water (Se 20-500 ug/L as selenate, sulfate 1-2 g/L); Se by ICP-MS (EPA 200.8), speciation by IC-ICP-MS
lab.logic: 10-12 wk synth ($15-25k) + 4 wk grafting/3 variants ($10k) + 4-6 wk tests; ~200 ICP-MS x $43-80 (UConn, USF) = ~$12k + speciation

sale.gates: on-site pilot at a coal mine 6-12 mo; permit/regulator acceptance of new process; integrator partner
